`web/AUTO_PIN.md`:

```md
# Verifier auto-pin

> **Hackathon work.** Built during the Meta AI Developer Hackathon, Oct 26 – Nov 4 2026. Everything else in `verify/`
> existed before the hackathon.

## What it does
A shared receipt link with no `?referee=` used to show **PARTIAL** (`referee_key_not_pinned`) even when the receipt
was signed by a QorTime referee on the built-in trusted list. Now, when the pin box is empty, the page pins the key
automatically **only** if it qualifies, and shows: "Referee key pinned automatically from QorTime's built-in trusted list."

A key qualifies only if it is:
1. an **active** row in `trusted_referees.json`, or
2. an online key (`key_kind` `qortime-official-review`) with a **valid, unrevoked delegation** from an allowlisted
   root, checked with the same `checkDelegation()` that `verifyReceipt()` uses.

## What it does not do
- `verify.js` / `verifyReceipt()` are **unchanged**. Auto-pin only chooses the `refereePub` argument that a person
  could already type by hand. It never yields a result a manual pin of the same key would not.
- Unknown, revoked, expired, local self-signed, referee-equals-player and malformed keys get **no pin**, so the
  verifier call is exactly what it was before.
- It never removes errors: a tampered receipt from a trusted referee still FAILs.
- A key typed by the user (or filled from `?referee=`) always wins; auto-pin never runs then.
- Gold is still only shown for VERIFIED (`goldAllowed`), unchanged.
- The Python library (`qor_receipt/receipt.py`) is unchanged; bare library calls still report `referee_key_not_pinned`.

## Files
- `web/auto-pin.js`: `autoPinFor(receipt, { allowlist, revocations, nowMs })` → `{ pin, source, reason }`.
- `verify/index.html` (upstream qortime, hook from PR #89; `web/demo.html` here): calls it in `check()` only when the pin box is empty.
- `web/auto-pin.test.mjs`: 30 checks (170123 auto-pinned = manual pin = VERIFIED, tampered still FAIL, unknown and
  forged keys unchanged, revoked/expired/out-of-scope delegations never pinned). Run: `node web/auto-pin.test.mjs`.

```

`web/advisory-fetch.js`:

```js
// HACKATHON (Meta AI Developer Hackathon, Oct 26 - Nov 4 2026): where the verifier looks for advisory sidecars.
// 1. a dropped file (handled by the page), 2. the sibling of a same-origin ?receipt= URL, 3. for an official-review
// receipt only, the referee's copy at /v1/advisory/{SHA-256(JCS(receipt))}/{name}, written automatically after the
// official verdict. Whatever is fetched still has to pass the advisory-key + receipt-hash checks in
// ai-ruling-view.js / score-crosscheck-view.js, and can never raise a verdict (lower-only.js). Missing = "Muse unchecked".
import { sha256Hex } from "../upstream/qortime/verify/verify.js";

export const ADVISORY_NAMES = ["ai_ruling.json", "score_crosscheck.json"];
const DEFAULT_API = "https://qortime-referee-production.up.railway.app";

export function refereeApi(search = (typeof location !== "undefined" ? location.search : "")) {
  const q = new URLSearchParams(search).get("referee_api");
  return q && /^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)(:\d+)?$/.test(q) ? q : DEFAULT_API;
}

export function isOfficialReview(receipt) {
  return !!(receipt && typeof receipt === "object" && receipt.review && typeof receipt.review === "object"
    && receipt.referee && receipt.referee.key_kind === "qortime-official-review");
}

export async function advisoryUrl(receipt, name, api = refereeApi()) {
  if (!ADVISORY_NAMES.includes(name) || !isOfficialReview(receipt)) return null;
  return `${api.replace(/\/$/, "")}/v1/advisory/${await sha256Hex(receipt)}/${name}`;
}

// Text of the advisory file or null. Never throws.
export async function fetchAdvisoryText(siblingUrl, receipt, name, { fetchFn = globalThis.fetch, api } = {}) {
  const get = async (u) => {
    if (!u) return null;
    try { const res = await fetchFn(u); return res && res.ok ? await res.text() : null; } catch { return null; }
  };
  const t = await get(siblingUrl);
  if (t != null) return t;
  try { return await get(await advisoryUrl(receipt, name, api || refereeApi())); } catch { return null; }
}

```

```mjs
// node web/advisory-fetch.test.mjs : verifier fallback to the referee's automatic advisory files (hackathon).
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { sha256Hex } from "../upstream/qortime/verify/verify.js";
import { advisoryUrl, fetchAdvisoryText, isOfficialReview, refereeApi } from "./advisory-fetch.js";

let fails = 0;
const ok = (c, m) => { console.log((c ? "ok   " : "FAIL ") + m); if (!c) fails++; };
const receipt = JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL("../examples/170123/receipt.json", import.meta.url)));
const sha = await sha256Hex(receipt);
const API = "https://qortime-referee-production.up.railway.app";

ok(isOfficialReview(receipt), "170123 is an official-review receipt");
ok(await advisoryUrl(receipt, "ai_ruling.json") === `${API}/v1/advisory/${sha}/ai_ruling.json`, "referee URL is bound to SHA-256(JCS(receipt))");
ok(await advisoryUrl(receipt, "hands.json") === null, "only the two Muse files are fetched from the referee");
const self = { ...receipt, referee: { ...receipt.referee, key_kind: "software" } };
ok(await advisoryUrl(self, "ai_ruling.json") === null, "self-signed receipts never trigger a referee fetch");
ok(refereeApi("?referee_api=https://evil.example") === API, "referee_api override only for localhost");
ok(refereeApi("?referee_api=http://127.0.0.1:8080") === "http://127.0.0.1:8080", "localhost override for staging");

const calls = [];
const fake = (map) => async (u) => { calls.push(u); return u in map ? { ok: true, text: async () => map[u] } : { ok: false }; };
ok(await fetchAdvisoryText("https://x/ai_ruling.json", receipt, "ai_ruling.json", { fetchFn: fake({ "https://x/ai_ruling.json": "S" }) }) === "S"
  && calls.length === 1, "sibling file wins, no referee request");
calls.length = 0;
ok(await fetchAdvisoryText("https://x/ai_ruling.json", receipt, "ai_ruling.json", { fetchFn: fake({ [`${API}/v1/advisory/${sha}/ai_ruling.json`]: "R" }) }) === "R"
  && calls.length === 2, "missing sibling falls back to the referee copy");
ok(await fetchAdvisoryText(null, receipt, "score_crosscheck.json", { fetchFn: fake({}) }) === null, "nothing anywhere = null (Muse unchecked)");
ok(await fetchAdvisoryText(null, receipt, "ai_ruling.json", { fetchFn: async () => { throw new Error("net"); } }) === null, "network error = null, never throws");
process.exit(fails ? 1 : 0);
```

`web/ai-ruling-view.js`:

```js
// Advisory AI explanation panel. Built during the Meta AI Developer Hackathon (Oct 26 - Nov 4 2026); see HACKATHON.md.
//
// Shows ai_ruling.json (qortime.ai_ruling.v0, written by Meta Muse Spark) ONLY when all of these hold:
//   * advisory_signature verifies under a key in ai_advisory_keys.inc.js (key_kind qortime-ai-advisory),
//   * that key is NOT a referee key (not on the trusted list, not the receipt's referee),
//   * receipt_jcs_sha256 equals SHA-256(JCS(this receipt)),
//   * verdict_echo.status equals the status verify.js just computed (a stale explanation is hidden),
//   * affects_verdict === false.
// Otherwise nothing is shown. The panel never changes the verdict, never uses gold, and renders text with textContent.
import * as ed from "../upstream/qortime/verify/vendor/noble-ed25519.js";
import { canonicalize, sha256Hex, lookupReferee } from "../upstream/qortime/verify/verify.js";
import { AI_ADVISORY_KEYS } from "./ai_advisory_keys.inc.js";

export const AI_SCHEMA = "qortime.ai_ruling.v0";
export const ADV_KIND = "qortime-ai-advisory";
const enc = new TextEncoder();
const hex = (b) => Array.from(b, (x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
const unhex = (s) => Uint8Array.from(String(s).match(/../g) || [], (x) => parseInt(x, 16));
const isHex = (s, n) => typeof s === "string" && new RegExp(`^[0-9a-fA-F]{${n}}$`).test(s);
const without = (o, k) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(o).filter(([x]) => x !== k));
const kidOf = async (pub) => hex(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", unhex(pub)))).slice(0, 16);

/** Generic checks for any sidecar signed with the AI advisory key (also used by score-crosscheck-view.js). Never throws. */
export async function advisorySignatureProblems(doc, receipt, schema, { keys = AI_ADVISORY_KEYS } = {}) {
  const p = [];
  try {
    if (!doc || typeof doc !== "object" || Array.isArray(doc)) return ["not_an_object"];
    if (doc.schema !== schema) p.push("schema");
    if (["signature", "signatures", "referee", "referee_ai"].some((k) => k in doc)) p.push("forbidden_field");
    const ak = doc.advisory_key || {}, sg = doc.advisory_signature || {};
    const pub = String(ak.pubkey || "").toLowerCase();
    if (ak.key_kind !== ADV_KIND) p.push("key_kind");
    const row = ((keys || {}).keys || []).find((r) => String(r.pubkey || "").toLowerCase() === pub);
    if (!row || row.status !== "active" || row.key_kind !== ADV_KIND) p.push("advisory_key_not_allowlisted");
    if (pub && (lookupReferee(pub) || pub === String((receipt && receipt.referee && receipt.referee.pubkey) || "").toLowerCase())) p.push("advisory_key_is_a_referee_key");
    let sigOk = false;
    if (isHex(pub, 64) && sg.alg === "Ed25519" && isHex(sg.sig, 128) && sg.key_id === (await kidOf(pub))) {
      try { sigOk = await ed.verifyAsync(unhex(sg.sig), enc.encode(canonicalize(without(doc, "advisory_signature"))), unhex(pub)); } catch { sigOk = false; }
    }
    if (!sigOk) p.push("bad_advisory_signature");
    if (!receipt || doc.receipt_jcs_sha256 !== (await sha256Hex(receipt))) p.push("receipt_mismatch");
  } catch (e) {
    p.push(`error:${e && e.name ? e.name : "error"}`);
  }
  return p;
}

/** Returns { ok, problems, text, model }. Never throws. */
export async function checkAiRuling(doc, receipt, status, { keys = AI_ADVISORY_KEYS } = {}) {
  const p = await advisorySignatureProblems(doc, receipt, AI_SCHEMA, { keys });
  if (p.length === 1 && p[0] === "not_an_object") return { ok: false, problems: p };
  if (doc.affects_verdict !== false) p.unshift("affects_verdict_not_false");
  if (!doc.verdict_echo || doc.verdict_echo.status !== status) p.push("verdict_echo_stale");
  if (typeof doc.explanation !== "string" || !doc.explanation.trim()) p.push("no_explanation");
  return p.length ? { ok: false, problems: p } : { ok: true, problems: [], text: doc.explanation.trim(), model: String(doc.model || "Muse Spark") };
}

/** DOM for a checked ruling (res.ok must be true). Plain text only; no gold. */
export function aiRulingPanel(res) {
  const el = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const sec = el("section", "panel reveal s-info ai-panel");
  sec.id = "p-ai"; sec.dataset.state = "info"; sec.setAttribute("aria-label", "AI explanation (advisory)");
  const head = el("header");
  head.append(el("h3", null, "AI explanation"));
  const chip = el("span", "chip s-info"); const dot = el("i"); dot.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true"); chip.append(dot, "advisory");
  head.append(chip);
  sec.append(head);
  const body = el("div", "ai-text");
  for (const para of res.text.split(/\n\s*\n/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 8)) body.append(el("p", null, para));
  sec.append(body);
  sec.append(el("p", "pnote", `Written by Meta ${res.model} from the referee's results and signed by QorTime's AI advisory key, which is not a referee key. It does not decide or change the verdict above.`));
  return sec;
}

```

`web/ai-ruling.test.mjs`:

```mjs
// node web/ai-ruling.test.mjs : advisory AI explanation panel checks (Meta AI Developer Hackathon; see PROVENANCE.md).
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import * as ed from "../upstream/qortime/verify/vendor/noble-ed25519.js";
import { canonicalize, sha256Hex, verifyReceipt } from "../upstream/qortime/verify/verify.js";
import { checkAiRuling } from "./ai-ruling-view.js";

let fails = 0;
const ok = (c, m) => { console.log((c ? "ok   " : "FAIL ") + m); if (!c) fails++; };
const read = (p) => JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL(p, import.meta.url)));
const hex = (b) => Array.from(b, (x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
const unhex = (s) => Uint8Array.from(s.match(/../g).map((x) => parseInt(x, 16)));
const kidOf = async (pub) => hex(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", unhex(pub)))).slice(0, 16);
const without = (o, k) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(o).filter(([x]) => x !== k));
async function resign(doc, priv) {
  const pub = hex(await ed.getPublicKeyAsync(priv));
  const d = { ...without(doc, "advisory_signature"), advisory_key: { ...doc.advisory_key, pubkey: pub, key_id: await kidOf(pub) } };
  d.advisory_signature = { alg: "Ed25519", key_id: await kidOf(pub), sig: hex(await ed.signAsync(new TextEncoder().encode(canonicalize(d)), priv)) };
  return { d, pub };
}

const receipt = read("../examples/170123/receipt.json");
const ruling = read("../examples/170123/ai_ruling.json");
const v = await verifyReceipt(receipt, receipt.referee.pubkey);
const vBefore = JSON.stringify(v);

let r = await checkAiRuling(ruling, receipt, v.status);
ok(r.ok && r.text.startsWith("STATUS") && r.text.includes("VERIFIED"), "published 170123 ai_ruling.json shows for the VERIFIED result");
ok(JSON.stringify(await verifyReceipt(receipt, receipt.referee.pubkey)) === vBefore, "checking the AI explanation does not change the verdict");
ok(!(await checkAiRuling(ruling, receipt, "PARTIAL")).ok, "hidden when the live verdict differs from the echoed one (stale)");
ok((await checkAiRuling(ruling, receipt, "PARTIAL")).problems.join() === "verdict_echo_stale", "stale is the only problem for an unpinned check");

const t1 = structuredClone(ruling); t1.explanation += " Extra words.";
ok((await checkAiRuling(t1, receipt, "VERIFIED")).problems.includes("bad_advisory_signature"), "edited explanation => hidden (bad signature)");
const t2 = structuredClone(receipt); t2.result.home_score = 3;
ok((await checkAiRuling(ruling, t2, "VERIFIED")).problems.includes("receipt_mismatch"), "explanation for another receipt => hidden");
const t3 = structuredClone(ruling); t3.signature = t3.advisory_signature; delete t3.advisory_signature;
ok(!(await checkAiRuling(t3, receipt, "VERIFIED")).ok, "a 'signature' field (referee-style) is never accepted");
const t4 = structuredClone(ruling); t4.affects_verdict = true;
ok((await checkAiRuling(t4, receipt, "VERIFIED")).problems.includes("affects_verdict_not_false"), "affects_verdict must be false");

const priv = ed.utils.randomPrivateKey();
const { d: other, pub: otherPub } = await resign(ruling, priv);
ok((await checkAiRuling(other, receipt, "VERIFIED")).problems.join() === "advisory_key_not_allowlisted", "validly signed by an unlisted key => hidden");
const keys = { keys: [{ id: "t", pubkey: otherPub, key_kind: "qortime-ai-advisory", status: "active" }] };
ok((await checkAiRuling(other, receipt, "VERIFIED", { keys })).ok, "same doc with that key allowlisted => shown (signature path works)");
ok(!(await checkAiRuling(other, receipt, "VERIFIED", { keys: { keys: [{ ...keys.keys[0], status: "revoked" }] } })).ok, "revoked advisory key => hidden");
const asRef = structuredClone(receipt); asRef.referee.pubkey = otherPub;
ok((await checkAiRuling(other, asRef, "VERIFIED", { keys })).problems.includes("advisory_key_is_a_referee_key"), "the receipt's referee key can't double as an advisory key");
for (const bad of [null, 1, "x", [], {}]) ok(!(await checkAiRuling(bad, receipt, "VERIFIED")).ok, `malformed ${JSON.stringify(bad)} => hidden`);
ok((await sha256Hex(receipt)) === ruling.receipt_jcs_sha256, "browser JCS hash == Python receipt_jcs_sha256");

const src = readFileSync(new URL("./ai-ruling-view.js", import.meta.url), "utf8");
ok(!/gold/i.test(src.replace(/never uses gold|no gold/gi, "")) && !/innerHTML/.test(src), "panel code has no gold styling and no innerHTML");
const css = readFileSync(new URL("./advisory-panels.css", import.meta.url), "utf8");
const aiCss = css.slice(css.indexOf("/* Hackathon: advisory AI explanation panel"));
ok(aiCss.length > 0 && !/gold|--gold|#d4af37|#ffd/i.test(aiCss.replace("never gold", "")), "panel CSS uses no gold");
process.exit(fails ? 1 : 0);
```

`web/auto-pin.js`:

```js
// Verifier auto-pin. Built during the Meta AI Developer Hackathon (Oct 26 - Nov 4 2026). See verify/AUTO_PIN.md.
//
// Problem: a shared receipt link with no ?referee= shows PARTIAL (referee_key_not_pinned) even when the receipt is
// signed by a QorTime referee on the built-in trusted list. Fix: when the pin box is empty, pick the pin ONLY from the
// built-in allowlist, never from the URL or the receipt alone.
//
// Safety rules (tests in verify/auto-pin.test.mjs):
//   * verify.js and verifyReceipt() are unchanged. Auto-pin only chooses the `refereePub` argument a person could
//     already type by hand, so it can never produce a result a manual pin of the same key would not.
//   * A key qualifies only if it is (a) an ACTIVE row on the built-in allowlist, or (b) an online key with a VALID,
//     unrevoked delegation from an allowlisted root (the same checkDelegation() verifyReceipt uses).
//   * Unknown, revoked, local self-attested, referee-equals-player and malformed keys return pin = null, so the call
//     to verifyReceipt is byte-for-byte what it was before (unknown referees behave exactly as before).
//   * Auto-pin never removes errors: a tampered receipt from a trusted referee still FAILs.
import { checkDelegation, lookupReferee, REVIEW_KEY_KIND } from "../upstream/qortime/verify/verify.js";
import { TRUSTED_REFEREES } from "../upstream/qortime/verify/trusted_referees.inc.js";
import { REFEREE_REVOCATIONS } from "../upstream/qortime/verify/referee_revocations.inc.js";

const HEX64 = /^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/;
const LOCAL_PREFIX = "local-self-attested";
export const AUTO_PIN_NOTE = "Referee key pinned automatically from QorTime's built-in trusted list.";

/** Returns { pin: hex|null, source: "allowlist"|"delegation"|null, reason } . Never throws. */
export async function autoPinFor(receipt, { allowlist = TRUSTED_REFEREES, revocations = REFEREE_REVOCATIONS, nowMs = null } = {}) {
  try {
    const none = (reason) => ({ pin: null, source: null, reason });
    if (!receipt || typeof receipt !== "object" || Array.isArray(receipt)) return none("not_a_receipt");
    const ref = receipt.referee;
    if (!ref || typeof ref !== "object") return none("no_referee");
    const pub = ref.pubkey;
    if (typeof pub !== "string" || !HEX64.test(pub)) return none("referee_pubkey_malformed");
    const want = pub.toLowerCase();
    if (String(ref.key_kind || "").startsWith(LOCAL_PREFIX)) return none("local_self_attested");
    const players = Array.isArray(receipt.players) ? receipt.players : [];
    if (players.some((p) => p && String(p.pubkey || "").toLowerCase() === want)) return none("referee_same_as_player");
    const row = lookupReferee(want, allowlist);
    if (row) {
      return row.status === "active" ? { pin: want, source: "allowlist", reason: `allowlisted:${row.id}` } : none(`not_active:${row.status}`);
    }
    if (ref.delegation == null) return none("not_on_allowlist");
    if (ref.key_kind !== REVIEW_KEY_KIND) return none("delegation_scope");
    const d = await checkDelegation(ref.delegation, want, (receipt.review || {}).reviewed_ms, { allowlist, revocations, nowMs });
    if (!d.info) return none(`delegation_invalid:${d.problems.join(",")}`);
    return { pin: want, source: "delegation", reason: `delegated:${d.info.id}:serial${d.info.serial}:from:${d.info.delegated_by}` };
  } catch {
    return { pin: null, source: null, reason: "error" };
  }
}

```

`web/auto-pin.test.mjs`:

```mjs
// node web/auto-pin.test.mjs : verifier auto-pin (Meta AI Developer Hackathon, Oct 26 - Nov 4 2026; see web/AUTO_PIN.md).
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import * as ed from "../upstream/qortime/verify/vendor/noble-ed25519.js";
import { canonicalize, sha256Hex, verifyReceipt, loadAllowlist } from "../upstream/qortime/verify/verify.js";
import { autoPinFor } from "./auto-pin.js";

let fails = 0;
const ok = (c, m) => { console.log((c ? "ok   " : "FAIL ") + m); if (!c) fails++; };
const hex = (b) => Array.from(b, (x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
const unhex = (s) => Uint8Array.from(s.match(/../g).map((x) => parseInt(x, 16)));
const enc = new TextEncoder();
const kidOf = async (pub) => hex(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", unhex(pub)))).slice(0, 16);
const signDoc = async (doc, priv) => ({ ...doc, sig: hex(await ed.signAsync(enc.encode(canonicalize(doc)), priv)) });
const same = (a, b) => JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);
const read = (p) => JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL(p, import.meta.url)));

// 1. Match 170123 (delegated online key, serial 2 from root qortime-v1): auto-pinned => VERIFIED, identical to a manual pin.
const live = read("../examples/170123/receipt.json");
const before = JSON.stringify(live);
const ap = await autoPinFor(live);
ok(ap.pin === live.referee.pubkey.toLowerCase() && ap.source === "delegation", "170123: auto-pin picks its delegated referee key");
const vAuto = await verifyReceipt(live, ap.pin);
const vManual = await verifyReceipt(live, live.referee.pubkey);
ok(vAuto.status === "VERIFIED" && vAuto.partial.length === 0 && vAuto.errors.length === 0, "170123: auto-pinned result is VERIFIED");
ok(same(vAuto, vManual), "170123: auto-pinned result is identical to the manual pin");
ok(JSON.stringify(live) === before, "170123: auto-pin does not modify the receipt");

// 2. Auto-pin never rescues a tampered receipt.
const tampered = structuredClone(live); tampered.result.home_score = 99;
const apT = await autoPinFor(tampered);
ok((await verifyReceipt(tampered, apT.pin)).status === "FAIL", "tampered 170123 is still FAIL with auto-pin");

// 3. Self-signed / ephemeral demo referee: never auto-pinned, result unchanged vs. no pin.
const d = read("../upstream/qortime/tests/vectors/demo_receipt_dual.json");
const apD = await autoPinFor(d.receipt);
ok(apD.pin === null && apD.reason === "not_on_allowlist", "ephemeral demo referee is never auto-pinned");
ok(same(await verifyReceipt(d.receipt, apD.pin), await verifyReceipt(d.receipt, null)), "unknown referee: result identical to before");
const sample = read("../upstream/qortime/verify/sample-receipt.json");
const apS = await autoPinFor(sample);
ok(apS.pin === null || loadAllowlist().referees.some((r) => r.status === "active" && r.pubkey.toLowerCase() === apS.pin) || apS.source === "delegation",
   "sample receipt is auto-pinned only if its key is trusted");

// 4. An attacker key that copies 170123's delegation cert is not pinned (delegation_key_mismatch).
const attackerPriv = ed.utils.randomPrivateKey();
const attackerPub = hex(await ed.getPublicKeyAsync(attackerPriv));
const forged = structuredClone(live); forged.referee.pubkey = attackerPub;
const apF = await autoPinFor(forged);
ok(apF.pin === null && apF.reason.includes("delegation_key_mismatch"), "copied delegation on an attacker key is not auto-pinned");
ok(same(await verifyReceipt(forged, apF.pin), await verifyReceipt(forged, null)), "attacker key: result identical to before");

// 5. Referee equals a player, local self-attested, malformed inputs.
const selfRef = structuredClone(live); selfRef.players[0].pubkey = selfRef.referee.pubkey;
ok((await autoPinFor(selfRef)).pin === null, "referee key equal to a player key is never auto-pinned");
const local = structuredClone(d.receipt); local.referee.key_kind = "local-self-attested-start-match";
ok((await autoPinFor(local)).pin === null, "local self-attested referee is never auto-pinned");
for (const bad of [null, 7, "x", [], {}, { referee: {} }, { referee: { pubkey: "zz" } }]) {
  ok((await autoPinFor(bad)).pin === null, `malformed input ${JSON.stringify(bad)} => no pin`);
}

// 6. Synthetic root + delegation: valid => pinned; revoked => not; root not allowlisted => not; revoked root row => not.
const rootPriv = ed.utils.randomPrivateKey(), rootPub = hex(await ed.getPublicKeyAsync(rootPriv)), rootKid = await kidOf(rootPub);
const delPriv = ed.utils.randomPrivateKey(), delPub = hex(await ed.getPublicKeyAsync(delPriv));
const allow = { referees: [{ id: "test-root", pubkey: rootPub, status: "active", can_delegate: true }] };
const cert = await signDoc({ type: "qortime-referee-delegation/v1", root_key_id: rootKid, delegate_pubkey: delPub, delegate_key_id: await kidOf(delPub),
  delegate_id: "test-online-s7", serial: 7, scope: ["official-review"], allowed_statuses: ["VERIFIED", "PARTIAL"],
  not_before_ms: 1000, not_after_ms: 1000 + 86400000 }, rootPriv);
const revNone = await signDoc({ type: "qortime-referee-revocations/v1", root_key_id: rootKid, revoked: [] }, rootPriv);
const revSeven = await signDoc({ type: "qortime-referee-revocations/v1", root_key_id: rootKid, revoked: [{ serial: 7 }] }, rootPriv);
const synth = { referee: { pubkey: delPub, key_kind: "qortime-official-review", delegation: cert }, players: [], review: { reviewed_ms: 5000 } };
const okDel = await autoPinFor(synth, { allowlist: allow, revocations: revNone, nowMs: 10000 });
ok(okDel.pin === delPub && okDel.source === "delegation", "valid delegation from an allowlisted root => auto-pinned");
const revoked = await autoPinFor(synth, { allowlist: allow, revocations: revSeven, nowMs: 10000 });
ok(revoked.pin === null && revoked.reason.includes("delegation_revoked:7"), "revoked delegation is never auto-pinned");
ok((await autoPinFor(synth, { allowlist: { referees: [] }, revocations: revNone, nowMs: 10000 })).pin === null, "delegation from a non-allowlisted root is never auto-pinned");
const late = structuredClone(synth); late.review.reviewed_ms = 1000 + 2 * 86400000;
ok((await autoPinFor(late, { allowlist: allow, revocations: revNone, nowMs: 1e13 })).pin === null, "expired delegation is never auto-pinned");
const wrongKind = structuredClone(synth); wrongKind.referee.key_kind = "something-else";
ok((await autoPinFor(wrongKind, { allowlist: allow, revocations: revNone, nowMs: 10000 })).pin === null, "delegation outside official-review scope is never auto-pinned");
ok((await autoPinFor({ referee: { pubkey: rootPub }, players: [] }, { allowlist: allow })).source === "allowlist", "active allowlisted root key => auto-pinned");
const allowRevoked = { referees: [{ id: "test-root", pubkey: rootPub, status: "revoked", can_delegate: true }] };
ok((await autoPinFor({ referee: { pubkey: rootPub }, players: [] }, { allowlist: allowRevoked })).pin === null, "revoked allowlist row is never auto-pinned");
ok((await autoPinFor(synth, { allowlist: allowRevoked, revocations: revNone, nowMs: 10000 })).pin === null, "delegation from a revoked root is never auto-pinned");

// 7. The page wires it only for an empty pin box and still sends every verdict through verify.js.
const page = readFileSync(new URL("./demo.html", import.meta.url), "utf8");
ok(/if \(!pin\) \{ auto = await autoPinFor\(currentReceipt\(\)\); pin = auto\.pin; \}/.test(page), "demo.html auto-pins only when the pin box is empty (upstream verify/index.html hook: qortime PR #89)");
ok(!/auto-pin|autoPin/.test(readFileSync(new URL("../upstream/qortime/verify/verify.js", import.meta.url), "utf8")), "verify.js has no auto-pin logic (library semantics unchanged)");
ok((await sha256Hex(live)).length === 64, "sanity");

process.exit(fails ? 1 : 0);
```

```mjs
// Demo (Node, offline): check the public VERIFIED match 170123 the way the browser does.
// 1. The verdict comes ONLY from the pre-existing verifier (upstream verify.js, fetched by scripts/fetch_upstream.sh).
// 2. Event-built code then: auto-pins a trusted referee key, checks the three signed advisory files
//    (Muse Spark explanation, Muse Spark score cross-check, Show Your Hands) and applies the lower-only rule.
```

`web/echo-view.js`:

```js
// Challenge Echo panel (display layer). Built Oct 27 2026 during the Meta AI Developer Hackathon (Oct 26 - Nov 4 2026).
//
// echo.sidecar.json (qortime.echo.v0) is written by qortime_ai/echo. In the browser it is INFO-ONLY: the panel never
// changes the status verify.js computed (the file is unsigned, so it is not allowed to lower anything here either).
// A malformed file, or one bound to a different receipt, shows no panel. verify.js is unchanged.
export const ECHO_SCHEMA = "qortime.echo.v0";
const STATES = ["consistent", "partial", "mismatch", "unscorable"];

async function sha256Hex(s) {
  const d = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(s));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(d), (x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}

/** { ok, problems, clips, summary, boundTo } . Never throws. `canonicalize` = verify.js JCS (for receipt binding). */
export async function checkEcho(doc, receipt, { canonicalize } = {}) {
  if (!doc || typeof doc !== "object" || Array.isArray(doc)) return { ok: false, problems: ["not_an_object"] };
  const p = [];
  if (doc.schema !== ECHO_SCHEMA) p.push("bad_schema");
  if (doc.affects_verdict !== "lower_only" || doc.max_cap !== "PARTIAL" || doc.emits_status !== false) p.push("not_lower_only");
  const clips = Array.isArray(doc.clips) ? doc.clips : [];
  if (!clips.length || clips.some((c) => !c || !STATES.includes(c.status))) p.push("bad_clips");
  let boundTo = "none";
  if (doc.receipt_jcs_sha256) {
    if (!receipt || !canonicalize) p.push("cannot_check_binding");
    else if ((await sha256Hex(canonicalize(receipt))) !== doc.receipt_jcs_sha256) p.push("other_receipt");
    else boundTo = "this_receipt";
  }
  if (p.length) return { ok: false, problems: p };
  return { ok: true, problems: [], clips, summary: String(doc.summary || ""), boundTo, pattern: doc.pattern || [] };
}

/** Status is returned untouched: Echo is info-only in the viewer. */
export const applyEcho = (v) => v;

const median = (xs) => { const s = xs.filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x)).sort((a, b) => a - b); return s.length ? s[(s.length - 1) >> 1] : null; };

export function echoRows(e) {
  return e.clips.map((c) => ({ id: String(c.id), status: c.status, dirs: `${c.directions_matched | 0}/${c.directions_total | 0}`,
    latency: Number.isFinite(c.latency_median_ms) ? c.latency_median_ms : null, jitter: Number.isFinite(c.jitter_ms) ? c.jitter_ms : null,
    menu: !!(c.menu && c.menu.appeared), tracker: String(c.tracker || "") }));
}

/** Panel DOM, or null when there is nothing valid to show. Never gold, never a verdict. */
export function echoPanel(e, { title = "Challenge Echo" } = {}) {
  if (!e || !e.ok) return null;
  const el = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const sec = el("section", "panel reveal s-unchecked xc-panel echo-panel");
  sec.id = "p-echo"; sec.setAttribute("aria-label", title);
  const head = el("header"); head.append(el("h3", null, title)); head.append(el("span", "chip s-unchecked", "Info only")); sec.append(head);
  const rows = echoRows(e);
  const med = median(rows.map((r) => r.latency));
  sec.append(el("p", "xc-line", `${e.summary} Median press-to-pixel ${med ?? "-"} ms.`));
  const tbl = el("table", "echo-table");
  const hr = el("tr"); for (const h of ["Window", "Directions", "Latency (median)", "Jitter", "Menu after OPTIONS", "Echo"]) hr.append(el("th", null, h));
  tbl.append(hr);
  for (const r of rows) {
    const tr = el("tr");
    for (const v of [r.id, r.dirs, r.latency == null ? "-" : `${r.latency} ms`, r.jitter == null ? "-" : `±${r.jitter} ms`, r.menu ? "yes" : "no", r.status]) tr.append(el("td", null, v));
    tbl.append(tr);
  }
  sec.append(tbl);
  sec.append(el("p", "pnote", "Challenge Echo checks that the pause-menu highlight in the video follows the logged D-pad presses (Meta SAM 3.1 tracks the highlight; the matching is deterministic code). `web/hands-view.js`:
```

```js
// Show Your Hands (display layer). Built during the Meta AI Developer Hackathon (Oct 26 - Nov 4 2026).
//
// hands.json (qortime.hands.v0) is written by qortime_ai/hands/sidecar.py. It is LOWER-ONLY and HIDDEN BY DEFAULT:
//   * shown only when its AI advisory signature, advisory key, and receipt binding all check out;
//   * a valid file with cap PARTIAL turns VERIFIED into PARTIAL; nothing here can raise a status or FAIL;
//   * no file, or an invalid one => no panel at all and the status exactly as verify.js computed it.
// verify.js is unchanged; gold still requires the final status VERIFIED.
import { advisorySignatureProblems } from "./ai-ruling-view.js";

export const HANDS_SCHEMA = "qortime.hands.v0";
export const HANDS_CODE = "show_your_hands_flags";
const BAD_KEY = /path|instance|serial|(^|_)(vid|pid)($|_)|gamertag|psn|device_id|hid_id|usb_id/i;
const BAD_VAL = /HID\\|USB\\|VID_|PID_|\\\\\?\\|&MI_/i;

function identifying(x) {
  if (Array.isArray(x)) return x.some(identifying);
  if (x && typeof x === "object") return Object.entries(x).some(([k, v]) => BAD_KEY.test(k) || identifying(v));
  return typeof x === "string" && BAD_VAL.test(x);
}

const flagsIn = (clips) => clips.filter((c) => c && c.scorable === true).reduce((n, c) => n + (Array.isArray(c.flags) ? c.flags.length : 0), 0);

/** { ok, problems, cap, inputs, clips, scorable, flags, summary }. Never throws. */
export async function checkHands(doc, receipt, opts = {}) {
  const p = await advisorySignatureProblems(doc, receipt, HANDS_SCHEMA, opts);
  if (p.length === 1 && p[0] === "not_an_object") return { ok: false, problems: p };
  if (doc.affects_verdict !== "lower_only" || doc.max_cap !== "PARTIAL") p.push("not_lower_only");
  if (doc.cap !== null && doc.cap !== "PARTIAL") p.push("bad_cap");
  const clips = Array.isArray(doc.clips) ? doc.clips : [];
  if (doc.cap === "PARTIAL" && (doc.inputs_verified !== true || flagsIn(clips) < 2)) p.push("cap_inconsistent");
  if (identifying(doc)) p.push("identifying_data");
  if (p.length) return { ok: false, problems: p };
  const inp = doc.inputs && typeof doc.inputs === "object" ? doc.inputs : {};
  return { ok: true, problems: [], cap: doc.cap, inputsVerified: doc.inputs_verified === true,
           reports: inp.reports | 0, chunks: inp.chunks | 0, clips: clips.length,
           scorable: clips.filter((c) => c && c.scorable === true).length, flags: flagsIn(clips),
           why: [...new Set(clips.map((c) => c && c.why).filter(Boolean))], summary: String(doc.summary || "") };
}

/** Copy of the verifier output with Show Your Hands applied (lower-only). Input is never mutated. */
export function applyHands(v, h) {
  if (!v || typeof v !== "object") return v;
  const out = { ...v, partial: [...(v.partial || [])] };
  if (!h || !h.ok) return out;
  out.show_your_hands = h.cap ? "flagged" : h.scorable ? "clean" : "not_scored";
  if (h.cap === "PARTIAL" && out.status === "VERIFIED") { out.status = "PARTIAL"; out.partial.push(HANDS_CODE); }
  return out;
}

const WHY = { too_few_anchors: "too few confirmed play starts to line the video up with the inputs",
              implausible_lag: "the video and input clocks did not line up", alignment_residual_too_large: "the video and input clocks did not line up" };

/** Panel DOM, or null when there is nothing valid to show (the panel stays hidden). Never gold. */
export function handsPanel(h) {
  if (!h || !h.ok) return null;
  const el = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const state = !h.inputsVerified ? "unchecked" : h.cap ? "partial" : h.scorable ? "pass" : "unchecked";
  const sec = el("section", `panel reveal s-${state} xc-panel hands-panel`);
  sec.id = "p-hands"; sec.dataset.state = state; sec.setAttribute("aria-label", "Show Your Hands");
  const head = el("header"); head.append(el("h3", null, "Show Your Hands"));
  const chip = el("span", `chip s-${state}`); const dot = el("i"); dot.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  chip.append(dot, !h.inputsVerified ? "Inputs unverified" : h.cap ? "Flags found" : h.scorable ? "Presses match" : "Inputs match");
  head.append(chip); sec.append(head);
  const n = (x) => Number(x).toLocaleString("en-US");
  if (h.inputsVerified) sec.append(el("p", "xc-line", `Controller inputs match the receipt: ${n(h.reports)} reports in ${n(h.chunks)} chunks, all committed by its checkpoints.`));
  const ptp = h.cap ? `Press-to-pixel: ${h.flags} flag(s) on the highlight clips. The result is shown as PARTIAL, not VERIFIED.`
    : h.scorable ? `Press-to-pixel: ${h.scorable} of ${h.clips} highlight clip(s) checked, no flags.`
    : `Press-to-pixel: not scored on these ${h.clips} highlight clips (${h.why.map((w) => WHY[w] || w).join("; ") || "nothing to align"}). No penalty.`;
  sec.append(el("p", "xc-line", ptp));
  sec.append(el("p", "pnote", "Show Your Hands checks that on-screen play starts have a controller press behind them. Meta Muse Spark only decides which on-screen motion is a real play start, so it can only remove candidates. This can lower VERIFIED to PARTIAL, never raise a status or fail a match. Inputs show a USB controller in sync with the video, not who held it. Signed by QorTime's AI advisory key, not a referee key."));
  return sec;
}
```

`web/lower-only.js`:

```js
// Guard for display-layer adjustments (hackathon, Oct 26 - Nov 4 2026). An adjusted result is accepted only if its
// status equals the verifier's, or is PARTIAL while the verifier said VERIFIED. Nothing can raise a status or turn a
// result into FAIL / SELF_ATTESTED from outside verify.js.
export function acceptLowerOnly(v, a) {
  if (!v || !a || typeof a !== "object") return v;
  if (a.status === v.status) return a;
  if (v.status === "VERIFIED" && a.status === "PARTIAL") return a;
  return v;
}
```

`web/score-crosscheck-view.js`:

```js
// Muse Spark score cross-check (display layer). Built during the Meta AI Developer Hackathon (Oct 26 - Nov 4 2026).
//
// score_crosscheck.json (qortime.score_crosscheck.v0) is written by qortime_ai/ai_ruling/score_crosscheck.py: Meta Muse
// Spark re-reads the scorebug after each locked score. It is LOWER-ONLY:
//   * applied only when its AI advisory signature, advisory key, and receipt binding all check out;
//   * agreement keeps the status; a disagreement turns VERIFIED into PARTIAL. Nothing here can raise a status or FAIL;
//   * no valid sidecar => "Muse unchecked": the verifier's status is shown exactly as verify.js computed it.
// verify.js is unchanged; this adjusts only what the page displays, and gold still requires the final status VERIFIED.
import { advisorySignatureProblems } from "./ai-ruling-view.js";

export const XC_SCHEMA = "qortime.score_crosscheck.v0";
export const XC_CODE = "muse_score_crosscheck_disagrees";

/** { ok, problems, cap, agree, disagree, checked, summary, cost_micro_usd }. Never throws. */
export async function checkCrosscheck(doc, receipt, opts = {}) {
  const p = await advisorySignatureProblems(doc, receipt, XC_SCHEMA, opts);
  if (p.length === 1 && p[0] === "not_an_object") return { ok: false, problems: p };
  if (doc.affects_verdict !== "lower_only" || doc.max_cap !== "PARTIAL") p.push("not_lower_only");
  if (doc.cap !== null && doc.cap !== "PARTIAL") p.push("bad_cap");
  const locks = Array.isArray(doc.locks) ? doc.locks : [];
  if ((doc.cap === "PARTIAL") !== locks.some((l) => l && l.result === "disagree")) p.push("cap_inconsistent");
  if (p.length) return { ok: false, problems: p };
  const n = (r) => locks.filter((l) => l && l.result === r).length;
  return { ok: true, problems: [], cap: doc.cap, agree: n("agree"), disagree: n("disagree"), checked: n("agree") + n("disagree"),
           summary: String(doc.summary || ""), model: String(doc.model || "muse-spark"), cost_micro_usd: doc.cost_micro_usd | 0 };
}

/** Copy of the verifier output with the cross-check applied (lower-only). Input is never mutated. */
export function applyCrosscheck(v, xc) {
  if (!v || typeof v !== "object") return v;
  const out = { ...v, partial: [...(v.partial || [])] };
  if (!xc || !xc.ok) { out.muse_crosscheck = "unchecked"; return out; }
  if (xc.cap === "PARTIAL" && out.status === "VERIFIED") { out.status = "PARTIAL"; out.partial.push(XC_CODE); }
  out.muse_crosscheck = xc.cap === "PARTIAL" ? "disagree" : xc.checked ? "agree" : "unchecked";
  return out;
}

/** Panel DOM. xc may be null (=> "Muse unchecked"). Never gold. */
export function crosscheckPanel(xc) {
  const el = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const state = !xc || !xc.ok || !xc.checked ? "unchecked" : xc.cap ? "partial" : "pass";
  const sec = el("section", `panel reveal s-${state} xc-panel`);
  sec.id = "p-muse-xc"; sec.dataset.state = state; sec.setAttribute("aria-label", "Muse Spark score cross-check");
  const head = el("header"); head.append(el("h3", null, "Score cross-check"));
  const chip = el("span", `chip s-${state}`); const dot = el("i"); dot.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  chip.append(dot, state === "pass" ? "Muse agrees" : state === "partial" ? "Muse disagrees" : "Muse unchecked");
  head.append(chip); sec.append(head);
  const line = state === "unchecked"
    ? "Muse unchecked: local scorebug reader only. No penalty."
    : `${xc.summary}.${xc.cap ? " The result is shown as PARTIAL, not VERIFIED." : ""}`;
  sec.append(el("p", "xc-line", line));
  sec.append(el("p", "pnote", "Meta Muse Spark independently re-reads the scorebug just after each locked score. Agreement keeps the status; a disagreement can only lower VERIFIED to PARTIAL. It never raises a status or fails a match. Signed by QorTime's AI advisory key, not a referee key."));
  return sec;
}
```

```mjs
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";

const read = (p) => JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL(p, import.meta.url)));
const hex = (b) => Array.from(b, (x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
const unhex = (s) => Uint8Array.from(s.match(/../g).map((x) => parseInt(x, 16)));

const without = (o, k) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(o).filter(([x]) => x !== k));

const keys = { keys: [{ id: "t", pubkey: pub, key_kind: "qortime-ai-advisory", status: "active" }] };
async function resign(doc) {
  const d = { ...without(doc, "advisory_signature"), advisory_key: { ...doc.advisory_key, pubkey: pub, key_id: await kidOf(pub) } };
  d.advisory_signature = { alg: "Ed25519", key_id: await kidOf(pub), sig: hex(await ed.signAsync(new TextEncoder().encode(canonicalize(d)), priv)) };
  return d;
}

const receipt = read("../examples/170123/receipt.json");
const xcDoc = read("../examples/170123/score_crosscheck.json");
const v = await verifyReceipt(receipt, receipt.referee.pubkey);
const vJson = JSON.stringify(v);

// 1. Published 170123 cross-check: valid, Muse agrees, status stays VERIFIED.
const xc = await checkCrosscheck(xcDoc, receipt);
ok(xc.ok && xc.cap === null && xc.agree >= 1 && xc.disagree === 0, "published 170123 cross-check is valid and agrees");
const a = applyCrosscheck(v, xc);
ok(a.status === "VERIFIED" && a.muse_crosscheck === "agree" && JSON.stringify(v) === vJson, "agreement keeps VERIFIED; verifier output not mutated");
ok(xcDoc.cost_micro_usd < 500000, "per-match cost recorded and well under $0.50");

// 2. A signed disagreement lowers VERIFIED to PARTIAL, and only that.
const dis = structuredClone(xcDoc); dis.locks[0].result = "disagree"; dis.cap = "PARTIAL";
const xcd = await checkCrosscheck(await resign(dis), receipt, { keys });
ok(xcd.ok && xcd.cap === "PARTIAL", "signed disagreement is accepted (test key)");

for (const st of ["PARTIAL", "SELF_ATTESTED", "FAIL"]) ok(applyCrosscheck({ ...v, status: st }, xcd).status === st, `disagreement leaves ${st} unchanged (never raises, never FAIL)`);

// 3. Invalid sidecars are ignored: status exactly as verify.js computed ("Muse unchecked").
ok((await checkCrosscheck(dis, receipt)).problems.includes("bad_advisory_signature"), "edited sidecar => bad signature => ignored");
ok(applyCrosscheck(v, await checkCrosscheck(dis, receipt)).status === "VERIFIED", "ignored sidecar => VERIFIED unchanged");
ok(applyCrosscheck(v, null).status === "VERIFIED" && applyCrosscheck(v, null).muse_crosscheck === "unchecked", "no sidecar => Muse unchecked, no penalty");
const other = structuredClone(receipt); other.result.home_score = 3;
ok((await checkCrosscheck(xcDoc, other)).problems.includes("receipt_mismatch"), "sidecar for another receipt => ignored");
const failCap = structuredClone(dis); failCap.cap = "FAIL";
ok((await checkCrosscheck(await resign(failCap), receipt, { keys })).problems.includes("bad_cap"), "a FAIL cap is never accepted");
const incons = structuredClone(xcDoc); incons.cap = "PARTIAL";
ok((await checkCrosscheck(await resign(incons), receipt, { keys })).problems.includes("cap_inconsistent"), "cap without a disagreeing lock is rejected");
const notLower = structuredClone(xcDoc); notLower.affects_verdict = true;
ok((await checkCrosscheck(await resign(notLower), receipt, { keys })).problems.includes("not_lower_only"), "must declare lower_only");
ok(!(await checkCrosscheck(await resign(dis), receipt)).ok, "validly signed by an unlisted key => ignored");
const asRef = structuredClone(receipt); asRef.referee.pubkey = pub;
ok((await checkCrosscheck(await resign(dis), asRef, { keys })).problems.includes("advisory_key_is_a_referee_key"), "referee key can't sign a cross-check");
for (const bad of [null, 3, "x", [], {}]) ok(!(await checkCrosscheck(bad, receipt)).ok, `malformed ${JSON.stringify(bad)} => ignored`);

// 4. Page guard: adjustments can only keep the status or lower VERIFIED to PARTIAL.
const S = ["VERIFIED", "PARTIAL", "SELF_ATTESTED", "FAIL"];
for (const from of S) for (const to of S) {
  const got = acceptLowerOnly({ status: from }, { status: to }).status;
  const want = to === from || (from === "VERIFIED" && to === "PARTIAL") ? to : from;
  ok(got === want, `guard ${from} -> ${to} gives ${want}`);
}
ok(acceptLowerOnly({ status: "PARTIAL" }, null).status === "PARTIAL", "guard ignores null");
ok(!/innerHTML|gold/i.test(readFileSync(new URL("./score-crosscheck-view.js", import.meta.url), "utf8").replace(/gold still requires|Never gold/g, "")), "panel: no innerHTML, no gold");
```

`web/seen-view.js`:

```js
// "What the referee saw" — SAM 3.1 Evidence Lens panel (display layer). Built Oct 27 2026 during the Meta AI Developer
// Hackathon (Oct 26 - Nov 4 2026).
//
// seen.json (schema seen.v0) is written by qortime_ai/seen: SAM 3.1 tracks the scorebug from the referee's own OCR region
// (box prompt) and "football player" masks split the frame-difference energy into players / HUD / rest. It is
// VISUALIZATION ONLY: it never feeds the referee, carries no status, and this panel never changes what verify.js shows.
// The Evidence Lens appears only inside receipt event windows (score lock, challenge window, the lock's segment).
// Colours: aqua by default; gold ONLY for a score lock when the verifier's own status is VERIFIED.
import { canonicalize } from "../upstream/qortime/verify/verify.js";

export const SEEN_SCHEMA = "seen.v0";
export const CORNER_LABEL = "SAM 3.1 · visualization, not a referee input";
export const MATERIALIZE_S = 0.3, DISSOLVE_S = 0.4;
const FORBIDDEN_KEYS = new Set(["status", "verdict", "cap", "max_cap", "masks", "boxes", "per_frame", "frames_data"]);
const BANNED = /attest|hardware[\s_-]*(verified|backed|proof|proven|secured)|certif(ied|y)|guarantee|cheat[\s_-]*(free|proof)/i;

const hex = (b) => Array.from(new Uint8Array(b), (x) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
async function sha256Hex(s) { return hex(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(s))); }

function findForbidden(o, path = "") {
  if (Array.isArray(o)) return o.flatMap((v, i) => findForbidden(v, `${path}[${i}]`));
  if (o && typeof o === "object") {
    return Object.entries(o).flatMap(([k, v]) => (FORBIDDEN_KEYS.has(k) ? [`${path}.${k}`] : []).concat(findForbidden(v, `${path}.${k}`)));
  }
  return [];
}

/** { ok, problems, clips }. Never throws. Binding: receipt_jcs_sha256 must match this receipt. */
export async function checkSeen(doc, receipt) {
  const p = [];
  if (!doc || typeof doc !== "object") return { ok: false, problems: ["not_an_object"] };
  if (doc.schema !== SEEN_SCHEMA) p.push("bad_schema");
  if (doc.affects_verdict !== false || doc.emits_status !== false) p.push("must_be_info_only");
  if (!String(doc.label || "").includes("not a referee input")) p.push("missing_label");
  const bad = findForbidden(doc);
  if (bad.length) p.push("forbidden_fields:" + bad.slice(0, 3).join(","));
  try {
    if (!receipt || doc.receipt_jcs_sha256 !== await sha256Hex(canonicalize(receipt))) p.push("receipt_mismatch");
  } catch { p.push("receipt_mismatch"); }
  const clips = Array.isArray(doc.clips) ? doc.clips : [];
  if (!clips.length) p.push("no_clips");
  for (const c of clips) for (const s of c.segments || []) if (BANNED.test(String(s.caption || "").replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g, " "))) p.push(`banned_word:${s.seq}`);
  return { ok: p.length === 0, problems: p, clips };
}

/** Lens colour: gold only for a score lock on a VERIFIED receipt. */
export function lensColor(kind, verifierStatus) { return kind === "score_lock" && verifierStatus === "VERIFIED" ? "gold" : "aqua"; }

/** Mirrors qortime_ai/seen/lens.py. null outside [t0, t1). */
export function lensState(ev, t, verifierStatus) {
  const t0 = Number(ev.t0), t1 = Number(ev.t1);
  if (!(t0 <= t && t < t1) || t1 <= t0) return null;
  const dur = t1 - t0, m = Math.min(MATERIALIZE_S, dur / 2), d = Math.min(DISSOLVE_S, dur / 2);
  const color = lensColor(ev.kind, verifierStatus);
  if (t < t0 + m) { const p = (t - t0) / m; return { phase: "materialize", p, alpha: p, color }; }
  if (t >= t1 - d) { const p = (t - (t1 - d)) / d; return { phase: "dissolve", p, alpha: 1 - p, color }; }
  return { phase: "hold", p: (t - t0 - m) / Math.max(dur - m - d, 1e-9), alpha: 1, color };
}

export function lensTag(ev, clip) {
  if (ev.kind === "score_lock") return `SCORE READ AWAY ${ev.score?.away}–HOME ${ev.score?.home} · [${ev.cite}]`;
  if (ev.kind === "motion_segment") {
    const s = (clip?.segments || []).find((x) => x.seq === ev.seq);
    return `MOTION SEGMENT ${ev.seq}${s ? ` · players ${s.motion_pct.players}%` : ""} · [${ev.cite}]`;
  }
  return `CHALLENGE WINDOW · [${ev.cite}]`;
}

const COLORS = { aqua: "#2EE6D6", gold: "#E8B84A" };

/** Draw one lens frame on a 2D context sized w x h (box_ref is in 640x360 space). */
export function drawLens(ctx, ev, st, w, h, clip) {
  if (!st || !Array.isArray(ev.box_ref)) return;
  const sx = w / 640, sy = h / 360, pad = 5;
  const [x1, y1, x2, y2] = [ev.box_ref[0] * sx - pad, ev.box_ref[1] * sy - pad, ev.box_ref[2] * sx + pad, Math.min(ev.box_ref[3] * sy + pad, h - 2)];
  const col = COLORS[st.color], a = st.alpha, grow = st.phase === "materialize" ? Math.max(st.p, 0.05) : 1;
  const L = Math.max(4, Math.min(x2 - x1, y2 - y1, 40) * 0.45 * grow);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = a; ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.shadowColor = col; ctx.shadowBlur = 14; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  for (const [cx, cy, dx, dy] of [[x1, y1, 1, 1], [x2, y1, -1, 1], [x1, y2, 1, -1], [x2, y2, -1, -1]]) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + dx * L * 2, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + dy * L); ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = a * 0.7; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; ctx.strokeRect(x1, y1, x2 - x1, y2 - y1);
  ctx.globalAlpha = a * 0.08; ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.fillRect(x1, y1, x2 - x1, y2 - y1);
  if (st.phase === "materialize") {
    const y = y1 + (y2 - y1) * st.p; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9; ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1, y); ctx.lineTo(x2, y); ctx.stroke();
  }
  if (st.phase !== "materialize" || st.p > 0.5) {
    const tag = lensTag(ev, clip); ctx.shadowBlur = 0; ctx.font = "12px ui-monospace, monospace";
    const tw = ctx.measureText(tag).width + 14, ty = y1 - 26 > 2 ? y1 - 26 : y2 + 6, tx = Math.min(Math.max(x1, 4), w - tw - 4);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a * 0.85; ctx.fillStyle = "#0B1020"; ctx.fillRect(tx, ty, tw, 20);
    ctx.globalAlpha = a; ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(tx, ty, tw, 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.fillText(tag, tx + 7, ty + 14);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

/** Panel DOM. seen = checkSeen() result. opts: { verifierStatus, stillUrl, stillClip, stillT, reducedMotion }. */
export function seenPanel(seen, opts = {}) {
  const el = (tag, cls, text) => { const n = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) n.className = cls; if (text != null) n.textContent = text; return n; };
  const sec = el("section", "panel reveal seen-panel"); sec.id = "p-seen"; sec.setAttribute("aria-label", "What the referee saw (SAM 3.1)");
  const head = el("header"); head.append(el("h3", null, "What the referee saw")); head.append(el("span", "chip seen-chip", "visualization only"));
  sec.append(head);
  if (!seen || !seen.ok) { sec.append(el("p", "pnote", "No valid seen.json for this receipt.")); return sec; }
  const clip = seen.clips.find((c) => c.id === opts.stillClip) || seen.clips[0];
  if (opts.stillUrl && typeof HTMLCanvasElement !== "undefined") {
    const wrap = el("div", "seen-stage"), img = el("img"), cv = el("canvas");
    img.src = opts.stillUrl; img.alt = "Public 170123 highlight frame"; wrap.append(img, cv, el("span", "seen-corner", CORNER_LABEL));
    sec.append(wrap);
    const reduce = opts.reducedMotion ?? (typeof matchMedia === "function" && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches);
    const t = Number(opts.stillT ?? clip.lock?.t_s ?? 0);
    const evs = (clip.lens_events || []).filter((e) => e.t0 <= t && t < e.t1);
    const paint = (sec2) => {
      const w = cv.width = img.clientWidth || 640, h = cv.height = img.clientHeight || 360, ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
      if (!ctx) return; ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
      for (const e of evs) {
        // Animated replay of the event window on the still; reduced motion = static hold frame.
        const tt = reduce ? (e.t0 + e.t1) / 2 : e.t0 + (sec2 % (e.t1 - e.t0 + 0.6));
        drawLens(ctx, e, lensState(e, tt, opts.verifierStatus), w, h, clip);
      }
    };
    if (reduce) img.addEventListener("load", () => paint(0));
    else { const t0 = performance.now(); const loop = (now) => { paint((now - t0) / 1000); if (sec.isConnected !== false) requestAnimationFrame(loop); }; img.addEventListener("load", () => requestAnimationFrame(loop)); }
  }
  const ul = el("ul", "seen-list");
  for (const c of seen.clips) {
    const sb = c.scorebug, m = c.motion_pct;
    ul.append(el("li", null, `${c.id}: scorebug in place ${sb.in_place}/${sb.frames} frames (max anchor move ${sb.max_anchor_jump_px} px)` +
      ` · motion energy players ${m.players}% · HUD ${m.hud}% · rest ${m.rest}%`));
  }
  sec.append(ul);
  sec.append(el("p", "pnote", "Meta SAM 3.1 tracks the scorebug from the referee's own OCR region and splits the referee's frame-difference energy into players / HUD / rest of screen. Visualization only: it is not a referee input, carries no status, and never changes the result above. Gold appears only on a score lock of a VERIFIED receipt."));
  return sec;
}

```

`web/seen-view.test.mjs`:

```mjs
// node web/seen-view.test.mjs : "What the referee saw" (SAM 3.1 Evidence Lens) panel checks. Built Oct 27 2026.
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { verifyReceipt } from "../upstream/qortime/verify/verify.js";
import { checkSeen, lensState, lensColor, lensTag } from "./seen-view.js";

let fails = 0;
const ok = (c, m) => { console.log((c ? "ok   " : "FAIL ") + m); if (!c) fails++; };
const read = (p) => JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL(p, import.meta.url)));
const receipt = read("../examples/170123/receipt.json");
const seenDoc = read("../examples/170123/seen.json");
const v = await verifyReceipt(receipt, receipt.referee.pubkey);
const vJson = JSON.stringify(v);

// 1. Published seen.json is valid, bound to this receipt, and info-only.
const s = await checkSeen(seenDoc, receipt);
ok(s.ok, "published 170123 seen.json is valid and bound to the receipt " + JSON.stringify(s.problems));
ok(seenDoc.affects_verdict === false && seenDoc.emits_status === false, "seen.json carries no status and affects nothing");
ok(JSON.stringify(v) === vJson && v.status === "VERIFIED", "verifier output untouched (VERIFIED from verify.js only)");

// 2. Tampering / mis-binding is rejected.
const other = structuredClone(receipt); other.result.home_score = 31;
ok(!(await checkSeen(seenDoc, other)).ok, "seen.json bound to a different receipt is rejected");
const withStatus = structuredClone(seenDoc); withStatus.clips[0].status = "VERIFIED";
ok((await checkSeen(withStatus, receipt)).problems.some((p) => p.startsWith("forbidden_fields")), "a status field anywhere is rejected");
const withMasks = structuredClone(seenDoc); withMasks.clips[0].masks = [[1, 2]];
ok(!(await checkSeen(withMasks, receipt)).ok, "per-frame mask data is rejected");
const banned = structuredClone(seenDoc); banned.clips[0].segments[0].caption = "This clip is certified clean [seen.seq].";
ok(!(await checkSeen(banned, receipt)).ok, "banned wording in a caption is rejected");

// 3. Evidence Lens appears ONLY inside receipt event windows.
let outside = 0, inside = 0;
for (const c of seenDoc.clips) {
  for (let f = 0; f < c.frames; f++) {
    const t = f / c.fps;
    for (const e of c.lens_events) {
      const st = lensState(e, t, "VERIFIED");
      if (t < e.t0 || t >= e.t1) outside += st === null ? 0 : 1; else inside += st ? 1 : 0;
    }
  }
}
ok(outside === 0 && inside > 0, `lens only inside event windows (inside frames ${inside}, leaks ${outside})`);
const ev = seenDoc.clips[1].lens_events.find((e) => e.kind === "score_lock");
ok(lensState(ev, ev.t0 + 0.1).phase === "materialize" && lensState(ev, ev.t0 + 1).phase === "hold" && lensState(ev, ev.t1 - 0.1).phase === "dissolve", "materialize -> hold -> dissolve");

// 4. Gold only for a score lock on a VERIFIED receipt.
ok(lensColor("score_lock", "VERIFIED") === "gold", "score lock + VERIFIED = gold");
for (const st of ["PARTIAL", "FAIL", "SELF_ATTESTED", undefined]) ok(lensColor("score_lock", st) === "aqua", `score lock + ${st} = aqua`);
for (const k of ["motion_segment", "challenge"]) ok(lensColor(k, "VERIFIED") === "aqua", `${k} is never gold`);
ok(lensTag(ev, seenDoc.clips[1]).includes("[checkpoints.away[459]]"), "score-lock tag cites the receipt checkpoint");

process.exit(fails ? 1 : 0);
```
